business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a café in Portland', 'a small publisher'.

sources.title: Where do customers leave feedback?
sources.description: e.g. 'Google and Yelp reviews and a receipt survey'.
sources.default: online reviews and a customer survey

tools.name: voice_status
tools.description: What customers are saying now: each theme with its count over the last 30 days, the 30 before and the trend, the feedback not yet sorted into a theme, the reviews that still need a reply (oldest first), and the open actions. Every entry has its id. Call it first when asked what customers say.

tools.name: log_feedback
tools.description: Save a review, survey answer or comment exactly as the customer wrote it: text, source, rating (1 to 5 stars), author, the day it was written (YYYY-MM-DD), and its themes by name (comma-separated; reuse names from the status, a new name starts a theme). Public reviews of 3 stars or fewer are marked as needing a reply. The same words from the same author update the entry, never duplicate it. Call it as soon as feedback is shared, before you discuss it.

tools.name: tag_feedback
tools.description: Sort feedback into themes: one id or several comma-separated ('fb-12, fb-13') and the theme names, reusing names from the status; a new name starts a new theme (kind: praise, problem or request). Call it as soon as you have decided, before you report it.

tools.name: save_reply
tools.description: Save a reply to a review, ready for the person to post where the review lives. Mention a fix only when an open action covers it, and never offer a refund, discount or free item the business has not agreed. Pass posted: true once the person says it is live. Call it as soon as the reply is drafted, before you show it.

tools.name: add_action
tools.description: Add an action the business agreed to take: title, the theme it answers (by name), owner and due date (YYYY-MM-DD). An existing title is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as an action is agreed, before you describe it.

tools.name: set_action_status
tools.description: Move an action to todo, doing or done, by id or title. Call it the moment the person says it moved.

tools.name: import_reviews
tools.description: Read a CSV of reviews or survey answers the person added under imports/ (e.g. 'imports/google-reviews.csv') into the log. Rows already in the log are skipped; new rows arrive unsorted.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.description: Every piece of feedback with its themes and replies, or only one theme (by name), plus the actions.

tools.name: page_log_feedback
tools.description: Log a review or survey answer.

tools.name: page_import_reviews
tools.description: Read an added CSV of reviews into the log.
